extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the count of orders by category. There was one exact duplicate row (row 31), which was removed. The Category column had label variants with extra spaces (e.g., 'Office Supplies ' and ' Furniture'), which were normalized to the allowed labels. The Price column had two values stored as text with a dollar sign (e.g., '$300.00'), which were safely converted to numbers. Most critically, row 40 had a Quantity of -6, which violates the rule that Quantity must be at least 1; this row was excluded. After these fixes, the analysis shows the count of orders per category: Accessories (9), Electronics (11), Furniture (14), and Office Supplies (12).
